description:
Trump has now admitted that his kids have insider information, and are using it to manage his stocks and turn a profit.

Now Trump is trading much more than Nancy Pelosi ever did.

Palantir, Dell, Nvidia and more — Trump is buying stocks and using his power to help drive them up.
title: We dug through Trump's 20,000 stock trades. It's even WORSE than you thought.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Trump’s sons found a way to profit from nearly $2 billion in government contracts.

One defense startup won $620 million in taxpayer money only three months after Trump Jr.’s firm took a stake in it.

We uncovered how the Trumps are using our money to enrich themselves.
